// client.ts
export async function load(client) { return client.fetch(); }
input.test: test('client fetch', async () => { const client = { fetch: mock(() => Promise.resolve({ id: 7 })) }; expect(await client.fetch()).toEqual({ id: 7 }); });
input.context: No hooks, helpers, mocks, imports or additional assertions are omitted.
input.contract: load should delegate retrieval to client.fetch and return the retrieved value.

rationale: The assertion repeats the mock's configured response without invoking production load.
